CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: OrderController.createOrder binds user-controlled PurchaseOrderDTO fields and returns the orders/new JSP after an error. The JSP interpolates order.orderNumber at line 63 and other fields using unescaped JSP EL, allowing a supplied HTML/JavaScript payload to be rendered.
